Overview Dynamic SAFe Senior Scrum Master, Project Manager with 14 years of overall experience, including 5+ years as a Scrum Master, managing development and Support projects. At Wipro, our team's agility has soared under my leadership as a Certified Scrum Master, where I've been instrumental in refining Scrum ceremonies and enhancing process implementations. The dedication to Agile principles has been key in delivering high-value products and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. Drawing from a wealth of experience in automation testing, I've brought a keen eye for detail and a commitment to operational efficiency to my current role. Our achievements include significant error reduction and heightened customer satisfaction, outcomes that speak to the strategic application of my competencies in project planning and key metrics analysis.

Competencies • Agile Methodologies • Scrum Values • Scrum Events/Ceremonies • Scrum Artifacts • Cross-Functional Team

Facilitation

Servant Leadership • Conflict Resolution • Coaching and Mentoring

Continuous Process Improvement

Stakeholder Engagement • Facilitation Ceremonies • Inter-Team Dependency Mitigation

Project Reporting & Delivery • Sprint Goals Planning

Team Building and Collaboration

Time Box Management • Risk and Dependency Management

User Story Creation and Prioritization

Project Coordinator

Certifications: PMP, Certified Scrum Master (CSM), SAFe. Tools: Microsoft Suite, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Azure Cloud, Azure DevOps, Power BI.

Professional Experience Aiden AI| Hyderabad Project Manager – AI and Cloud Transformation Aiden AI | Client: Aon (Benefits & Claims Vertical) •

March 2026 – till date

Led end-to-end delivery of AI, automation, and cloud transformation programs, managing project lifecycles from initiation through production deployment using Agile and Scrum methodologies.

Managed multiple AI-driven initiatives supporting Aon's Benefits and Claims business units, ensuring alignment with business objectives, compliance requirements, and operational priorities.

Defined project roadmaps, sprint plans, milestones, release schedules, and delivery metrics to ensure predictable execution and stakeholder transparency.

Coordinated cross-functional teams consisting of AI Engineers, Data Scientists, Cloud Architects, QA teams,



Business Analysts, and Product Owners to deliver scalable enterprise solutions. Facilitated Agile ceremonies including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog grooming, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to improve delivery velocity and team effectiveness.

Directed cloud migration and deployment activities from Microsoft Azure to Amazon Web Services (AWS), ensuring minimal business disruption and successful production cutovers.

Partnered with business stakeholders and client leadership to gather requirements, prioritize features, manage scope, and drive strategic decision-making.

Monitored project risks, dependencies, and resource allocation while implementing mitigation plans to maintain schedule and budget objectives.

Managed AI solution delivery pipelines, coordinating development, testing, deployment, and post-production support activities.

Enabled adoption of agentic AI workflows, intelligent automation frameworks, and prompt-engineering practices to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

Utilized JIRA for project planning, documentation, sprint tracking, and knowledge management.

• Drove continuous process improvement initiatives, reducing delivery bottlenecks and enhancing project

governance across multiple workstreams.

Actively coaches, mentors, and trains Agile teams, Product Owners, and Project Managers, removing impediments and reinforcing Agile practices.

Facilitating the Sprint Planning, Product Backlog Refinement, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives Sessions on frequent basis to identify problems and continuous improvements.

Ensuring the Scrum teams fully understand the overall program of work, the deployment schedule, project, and dependencies.

Supported delivery of healthcare payer workflows payment/remittance, and healthcare data exchange processes.
